data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English, Adley is a feminine name meaning 'noble one'. The name is composed of two parts: 'Adla' meaning 'noble', and 'weald' meaning 'rule'. The name has a regal and elegant feel, and was popular in medieval England. The name Adley carries the meaning “Noble one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Adley usually hope their child will grow to embody noble one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
